items.quote: Sergio and his team are the best at what they do. They completely renovated my grandma's kitchen and did an impeccable job. They completed the job quicker than expected and were extremely helpful throughout the whole process.

I can't recommend Sergio and his company highly enough. From start to finish, the experience was seamless and stress free. Sergio was incredibly professional, responsive, and attentive to every detail.

Had a leak from my shower into the surrounding tile. Sergio and team gave me a great price for the repair and finished the work timely. I would highly recommend them for any work needed around the house.
